# Proposed Fix — guard_snapshot dirty-tree crash

## Root cause
`run_pipeline.py:guard_snapshot()` raises `Stuck` because 12 pipeline files in the
working tree differ from HEAD:

```
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/registry/anchor_mapping.json
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/registry/runtimes.json
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/sandbox/package.json
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/schemas/ix.code_exercise.schema.json
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/data.py
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/pysyntax.py
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/sandbox.py
 D 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/sheetsyntax.py
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/practice_survey.py
 M 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/selftest.py
 M 01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/04_interactions/EVALUATOR.md
 M 01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/04_interactions/GENERATOR.md
```

`git diff --stat HEAD` shows these are the spreadsheet/chart_renderer additions
(~740 lines removed from working tree vs HEAD, matching commits `1877030`, `cc3e9c5`,
`8a38864` that came *after* the current HEAD `bfc5cdc`).  The working tree is ahead
of HEAD — the changes are intentional but uncommitted.

## Fix (human action required — cannot be done by the pipeline)

**Option A — commit the changes (recommended):**
```bash
cd /home/ubuntu/devspace-final-schema-pipeline
git add 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/registry/anchor_mapping.json \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/registry/runtimes.json \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/sandbox/package.json \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/schemas/ix.code_exercise.schema.json \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/data.py \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/pysyntax.py \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/sandbox.py \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/checkers/sheetsyntax.py \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/practice_survey.py \
        00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/selftest.py \
        01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/04_interactions/EVALUATOR.md \
        01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/04_interactions/GENERATOR.md
git commit -m "Commit pipeline changes so guard_snapshot passes for batch 008"
```

**Option B — revert working tree to HEAD (only if changes are NOT wanted):**
```bash
git checkout -- 00_FINAL_PIPELINE_CORE/ 01_FINAL_PACK_TEMPLATE/
```

After either option, rerun the pipeline normally (no `--allow-dirty-code` needed).

## Secondary issue (content, not blocking the restart)
`04_interactions:c3` has failed repeatedly on the same gate error:
  `tile_python_errors_imports.s06`: solution uses `attr:sqrt` / `import:math`
  which is not in the practice's allowed_syntax.
  `tile_python_functions_scope.s14`: solution uses `kw:city` / `kw:order_id`
  not in allowed_syntax.
These have survived 3+ repair rounds each.  After the dirty-tree issue is resolved,
monitor whether c3 resolves on the next run; if it stops again on the same errors,
a human will need to review the glossary anchor for those practices.
